name: Our Ticket to Win!

description: When near the inner rail midpack on the final corner or later, slightly increase velocity and ability to navigate smoothly on the final straight.
name: trigger:BEAT

description: Slightly increase velocity in a dash for the lead after running calmly and according to plan up until the final straight.
name: Schwarzes Schwert

description: Very slightly begin to advance when passing another runner while well-positioned around halfway through the race.
name: #LookatCurren

description: Slightly increase velocity when engaged in a challenge on the final straight.
name: A Princess Must Seize Victory!

description: Very slightly increase acceleration steadily when starting to make a move from midpack in the second half of the race.
name: KEEP IT REAL.

description: Slightly increase velocity when engaged in a challenge toward the front in the second half of the race.
name: Genius x Bakushin = Victory

description: If positioned toward the back and racing calmly until the start of the final corner, when there are 300m remaining, slightly increase velocity continuously.
name: Victory Belongs to Me—Strelitzia! ☆

description: Moderately recover endurance when well-positioned mid-race.
name: Pure Heart

description: Become very slightly empowered to keep the advantage when positioned toward the front and close to the runner behind on a straight mid-race.
name: SPARKLY☆STARDOM

description: Slightly increase velocity when pressured by or passing another runner while well-positioned on the final straight.
name: Pop & Polish

description: Slightly increase velocity when moving up from midpack on the final corner or later.
name: Nemesis

description: If the user engaged in a challenge on a mid-race corner, slightly increase acceleration when well-positioned late-race at least halfway through the final corner.
name: Budding Blossom

description: Slightly recover endurance with a glance at nearby runners when positioned toward the back on the final corner.
name: Super-Duper Climax

description: Slightly clear a path forward depending on divination results when the way ahead is jammed late-race.
name: I See Victory in My Future!

description: Very slightly aim for the front when passing another runner from midpack or further back on a corner late-race.
name: I Never Goof Up!

description: Having run the race calmly, slightly increase acceleration when making a move mid-race, or on a crucial corner late-race whilst in midpack.
name: Moving Past, and Beyond

description: Slightly increase velocity when positioned 3rd and about to lose late-race.
name: Just a Little Farther!

description: Moderately increase velocity in a true display of skill with 200m remaining after racing calmly.
name: Prideful King

description: Slightly recover endurance and very slightly increase velocity when in midpack around halfway through the race.
name: Go, Go, Mun!

description: If positioned toward the front from the start of the race until the second half of the race, slightly recover endurance and very slightly increase velocity steadily.
name: Keep Pushing Ahead

description: If well-positioned at the start of the final straight, slightly increase velocity. If positioned near the front, moderately increase velocity instead.
name: Eternal Encompassing Shine

description: Very slightly increase velocity when positioned toward the front on the third corner in the second half of the race. Or, very slightly kick forward when toward the front on the backstretch late-race.
name: Victory Cheer!

description: Slightly increase velocity when well-positioned and close to the runner ahead with 300m or less remaining.
name: Ambition to Surpass the Sakura

description: Slightly consume endurance to moderately increase velocity for a moderate duration when close to the runner behind on the final straight.
name: A Lifelong Dream, A Moment's Flight

description: If the user passed another runner on the final corner or later, slightly increase velocity when in the front part of the pack with 300m or less remaining.
name: Peerless Dance of Flowering Flames

description: From the midpack in the second half of the race, minimally increase velocity steadily for a duration based on remaining endurance.
name: Lovely Spring Breeze

description: Slightly recover endurance after activating 2 skills mid-race.
name: Dazzl'n ♪ Diver

description: Moderately increase velocity on the final straight after being on the heels of another runner toward the front on the final corner or later.
name: Certain Victory

description: Slightly increase velocity when positioned toward the front in the second half of the race after recovering endurance with a skill.
name: A Kiss for Courage

description: When passing another racer at the front part of the pack on the final corner or later, moderately increase velocity for a moderate duration.
name: Ravissant

description: Very slightly control breathing and kick forward toward victory in the second half of the race after recovering endurance with skills at least 3 times.
name: Festive Miracle

description: If positioned toward the front with 200m remaining, slightly increase velocity. Then, if also positioned near the leading Umamusume, move minimally forward.
name: Joyful Voyage!

description: Moderately recover endurance when overtaken toward the back mid-race.
name: Superior Heal

description: Slightly increase velocity continuously when pressured by another runner and running out of energy toward the front on the final corner or later.
name: Legacy of the Strong

description: Slightly increase acceleration when aiming for the front from midpack on the final corner.
name: Condor's Fury

description: Slightly increase velocity for a moderate duration when in the front part of the pack with 400m remaining. If at least 7 skills have been activated, moderately increase velocity for a moderate duration instead.
name: Barcarole of Blessings

description: Slightly increase velocity when pressured by another runner in the front part of the pack on the final corner or later.
name: Arrows Whistle, Shadows Disperse

description: Slightly increase velocity when starting to make a move from a position toward the front mid-race.
name: Eternal Moments

description: If positioned toward the front on a straight late-race, slightly increase velocity. If the straight is on the backstretch, also increase acceleration very minimally.
name: Break It Down!

description: If well-positioned late-race on the final corner or later, slightly increase velocity. If there's a large distance left to the finish, also increase acceleration very minimally.
name: Best day ever

description: Slightly increase velocity mid-race after staying well-positioned from the start of the race up until the second half.
name: Presents from X

description: Slightly increase velocity when passing another runner toward the front on the final corner. If passing toward the back, slightly increase acceleration instead.
name: Flowery☆Maneuver

description: Take a minimal breather and slightly increase velocity when in the front part of the pack and there's another runner coming from behind on a corner mid-race.
name: Operation Cacao

description: Slightly drain endurance from runners ahead when well-positioned and pressured by another runner mid-race.
name: Every Rose Has Its Fangs

description: Slightly increase velocity continuously on the final straight after passing another runner 3 times on the final corner or later.
name: Guten Appetit ♪

description: If positioned toward the front with 350m remaining and there is another Umamusume close behind, break out of the pack slightly more easily.
name: One True Color

description: Very slightly increase ability to break out of the pack when engaged in a challenge in midpack on the final corner.
name: Dancing in the Leaves

description: Very slightly increase ability to break out of the pack when well-positioned and close to the runner ahead on the final straight.
name: Give Mummy a Hug ♡

description: Give max effort when far from the lead on the final corner, very slightly increasing velocity steadily for a duration proportional to distance from the lead.
name: 114th Time's the Charm

description: Slightly increase velocity with a surge of fortune when pressured by another runner toward the back in the second half of the race.
name: Bountiful Harvest

description: If positioned midpack on a downhill just before late-race and there's a large distance left to the finish, slightly increase velocity.
name: Wherever This Wonder Leads

description: If the user passed another runner on the final corner or later, slightly increase velocity from the midpack onward on the final straight. If the user isn't one of the top favorites, keep steadily increasing velocity slightly.
name: Go☆Go☆Goal!

description: If the user stayed toward the very back during the first half of the race without being rushed, slightly increase acceleration on the final straight.
name: Louder! Tracen Cheer!

description: If the user activates another skill on the final corner late-race, very slightly increase velocity. If racing at Nakayama Racecourse, moderately increase velocity instead.
name: Dreams Donned with Pride!

description: Increase attributes by +{0}％ in the Racing Carnival. {1}％ chance to also raise runner's mood to Great. This skill will disappear when the event ends.
name: Carnival Bonus

description: Increase attributes by +{0}％ in the Racing Carnival. {1}％ chance to also raise runner's mood to Great. This skill will disappear when the event ends.
name: Carnival Bonus

description: Greatly decrease the racer's proficiency in starting races. Effects include slow starts and reduced starting acceleration. Removed at the end of the Career playthrough.
name: Feelin' a Bit Silly

description: Increase performance in Medium Turf races. This skill is exclusive to the event.
name: Medium Race Enthusiast

description: Increase performance in Long Turf races. This skill is exclusive to the event.
name: Long Race Enthusiast

description: Increase performance in Mile Turf races. This skill is exclusive to the event.
name: Mile Race Enthusiast
